weak_density_remark.label: PROVED (elementary), not load-bearing
weak_density_remark.statement: finitely supported laws are weakly dense in the probability measures on [0,1], and gap(mu,nu,q) is jointly weakly continuous in (mu,nu) because every kernel is continuous on the compact square; hence the general theorem is also the weak closure of the finitely supported one. The direct proof above never takes a limit, so no modulus of continuity of h (which is not Lipschitz at 0, 1) is needed.
